entities.summary: Wolfgang Friedrich Wilhelm Siegfried Pickert was a general in the Luftwaffe of Nazi Germany during World War II who commanded the III Flak Corps. He was a recipient of the Knight's Cross of the Iron Cross with Oak Leaves.
